title: Integral Means Spectrum for the Random Riemann Zeta Function
summary: We study the integral means spectrum associated with the analytic function whose derivative is the so-called randomized Riemann zeta-function, introduced some time ago by Bagchi. The randomized $ζ$-function, $ζ_{\mathrm{rand}}(σ+ih)$, is known to represent the asymptotic statistical behaviour of the random vertical shifts of the actual $ζ$-function in the critical strip, $1/2 <σ\leq 1, h\in \mathbb R$, and appears in a number of recent works on the asymptotic behavior of the moments and maxima of the $ζ$-function on short intervals along the critical axis $σ=1/2$.
